items.author: Coinvo
items.context: Coinvo comparte un video y dice que Adam Back advierte que Wall Street está entrando en la custodia de Bitcoin; según el post, los críticos dicen que esto mata la autocustodia y centraliza el control, una amenaza directa de los bancos a la promesa original de Bitcoin.
items.suggested_text: Wall Street holding coins isn't the threat by itself. The threat is people forgetting they can opt out. Self-custody doesn't have to mean trusting an exchange or a hardware vendor either. I wrote a step-by-step guide to building your own air-gapped setup, free on Kindle until Wednesday: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: pepetoshi
items.context: Pepetoshi comenta que, según BlackRock, grandes holders están cambiando bitcoin en autocustodia por su ETF, con más de 5.000 millones de dólares en conversiones in-kind, sobre todo por preocupaciones de seguridad; ironiza que mucha gente solo quería que otro se preocupara de las llaves.
items.suggested_text: That's the honest version of the trade-off. The ETF doesn't remove the key risk, it moves it to someone you can't audit. Holding your own keys gets a lot less scary once you understand each step instead of trusting a device or an app blindly.

items.author: SatoshiDropsHQ
items.context: Satoshi Drops dice que 3.600 millones de dólares en $BTC se cambiaron in-kind al IBIT de BlackRock, mayormente por seguridad, y pregunta a sus seguidores: ¿autocustodia o ETF?
items.suggested_text: Self-custody. I get why people pick the ETF, the fear is real and bad setups are real. The fix is learning to do it properly, offline, without depending on an exchange or a device maker. I put the whole process in a guide: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2119476332635586800

items.author: TheMoonHailey
items.context: Hailey dice que ya había advertido que 87K era la última trampa alcista y que $BTC volvería a 75K–73K; su plan: 75K → 70K (piso) → 80K → 87K → 100K, y pide guardar el post para revisarlo en unos meses.
items.suggested_text: $75K to $70K to $100K is a clean roadmap, but the path is the part nobody controls. If that $70K bottom comes, it's a buying chance for spot holders and a liquidation for anyone leveraged long on the way down. Same call, very different outcome depending on how you hold $BTC.
